table.name: Table
table.purpose: Compare structured records by columns, sort values, select rows, and inspect row-level detail.

anatomy.rule: Wraps comparable records in a stable surface.
Names columns and exposes sortable headers.
Render comparable records with stable alignment.
Marks selected row without changing columns.

variants.description: Compact operational table for desktop-heavy surfaces.
Column headers expose local sort controls.

table.statePrecedence: expanded > selected > sorted > focus > hover > default

Energy.decision: Use semantic surfaces, selected row color, and readable headers.
Energy.test: Verify contrast for header, row, and selected rail.

Voice.decision: Use short column headers and clear empty or detail copy.

Frame.decision: Use stable cell padding, alignment, and responsive column strategy.
Frame.test: Verify phone reduced columns and desktop width.

Depth.decision: Use one card surface for table boundary.
Depth.behavior: Table reads as one data object.
Depth.test: Verify no nested cards per row.

Momentum.decision: Use subtle state and sort feedback from Design System motion.

State.decision: Resolve expanded, selected, sorted, focus, hover, and default explicitly.
State.behavior: Row and column state is visible.

Tone.decision: Use tone in cells or badges only when data meaning requires it.
Tone.behavior: Severity belongs to data, not layout.

Growth.decision: Escalate filters, bulk actions, editable workflows, table trees, timelines, remote data, and pagination to patterns/templates.
Growth.example: Expandable row opens details; edit opens Drawer.
Growth.rejectIf: Table absorbs filtering, bulk actions, editable workflows, timelines, tree navigation, or remote orchestration.

Symbol.decision: Use sort and expand icons with visible labels or headers.

Iconography.decision: Use Design System icon sizes in header and row controls.

Accessibility.decision: Use table semantics, scope col, aria-sort, row keys, and keyboard-visible controls.
Accessibility.behavior: Assistive tech users can navigate records.
Accessibility.test: Verify headers, aria-sort, focus, and row actions.
Accessibility.rejectIf: Table is div layout or sortable headers are not buttons.

props.name: columns
props.notes: Column definitions with label, key, align, mono, render, and sort behavior.

props.name: state
props.type: default | hover | focus | selected | sorted | expanded

props.name: onRowSelect
props.notes: Called when a row is selected.

dont: Do not use as layout grid.
Do not force many columns into phones.
Do not hide row actions from keyboard users.
info: Use List when comparison is not the task.

contextDensityStrategy.layout: full comparison table with sort and selection

agentInstructions: Use Table for shared-field record comparison.
Ask before adding sensitive columns or bulk destructive actions.
Define columns, row key, sort fields, selection, and constrained viewport behavior.
